description: Watch a TikTok, Instagram Reel, YouTube Short/video, Pinterest, Facebook or X video link (or a web page) and return its transcript, on-screen text, caption and a structured extract. On the Extract + Video plan it also returns a download link for the original video (every file of a carousel). If the result isn't ready yet, returns a job_id.
name: parse_video
title: Watch a video link
